# Code Review Instructions

## Review Focus Areas
- Security vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, auth bypass)
- Error handling and edge cases
- Performance issues (N+1 queries, unnecessary allocations)
- Code consistency with existing patterns

## Project Conventions
- [Add your project's coding conventions here]
- [Add preferred patterns and anti-patterns]

## Severity Levels
- 🔴 Critical: Must fix before merge (security, data loss, crashes)
- 🟡 High: Should fix (bugs, performance, missing error handling)
- 🟢 Medium: Nice to fix (refactoring, readability)
- 💬 Low: Nitpick (style, naming)
